key_insight: fix: parseLLMJson truncation salvage + computeScore NaN on non-numeric strings
outcome:
Two compass CLI robustness fixes.

**parseLLMJson — truncation salvage**
When gpt-4o hits the output token limit mid-object (common with 5+ pathways/bets), JSON.parse throws and the whole command fails. Fix: after the initial parse fails, trim to the last complete `},` boundary and attempt to close the container. Falls through to the original error if salvage also fails.
